create_formatter_json: create a json formatter that converts objects to json strings with custom dumper arguments
create_formatter_yaml: create a yaml formatter that converts objects to yaml strings using OmegaConf
create_formatter_python: create a python formatter that converts any object to its string representation
create_formatter_none: create a none formatter that returns None for any input object
get_formatter: get a configured formatter by name from the available formatters: none, python, json, yaml
